description:
The Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India. 

The scheme was officially launched on 1st November 2021. 

It aims to provide a safe and nurturing environment for children aged 0 to 6 years. 

The primary objective of the Maa-Badi scheme is to enhance early childhood care and education. 

The scheme focuses on providing quality daycare services to working parents. 

It is designed to support the holistic development of children in their formative years. 

The government aims to establish 1,000 Maa-Badi centres across the state. 

Each centre is expected to cater to approximately 30 children. 

The target is to enroll around 30,000 children in these centres within the first year. 

The scheme also aims to provide nutritional support to children. 

Under the scheme, children will receive a nutritious meal daily. 

The meal will consist of locally sourced ingredients to promote health and well-being. 

The nutritional component is crucial for the physical and cognitive development of children. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of early childhood education. 

It aims to prepare children for formal schooling by providing foundational skills. 

The curriculum will include activities that promote language development, motor skills, and social interaction. 

The Maa-Badi centres will be staffed by trained caregivers and educators. 

Each caregiver will be required to undergo training in early childhood education. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for the establishment of these centres. 

The funding will cover infrastructure development, training, and operational costs. 

Parents will be required to pay a nominal fee for enrolling their children. 

The fee structure is designed to be affordable for low-income families. 

The maximum fee charged will not exceed ₹500 per month. 

This nominal fee will help sustain the operational costs of the centres. 

Eligibility for enrollment in the Maa-Badi centres includes children aged between 0 to 6 years. 

Parents or guardians must be working or engaged in vocational activities. 

There are no specific income criteria for enrollment. 

However, priority will be given to families from economically weaker sections. 

The application process for the Maa-Badi scheme is straightforward. 

Parents must fill out an application form available at local government offices or online. 

The application form requires basic information about the child and the parents. 

Documents required include proof of age such as a birth certificate. 

Parents must also provide proof of employment or vocational engagement. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the local authorities. 

Successful applicants will receive a confirmation of enrollment. 

The centres will operate throughout the year. 

They will follow a structured timetable that includes playtime, learning activities, and meal times. 

The Maa-Badi centres will also conduct regular health check-ups for enrolled children. 

Health screenings will be carried out every six months. 

The aim is to monitor the growth and development of children. 

The scheme will also include parental workshops. 

These workshops will focus on child development and parenting skills. 

They will be held quarterly to engage parents in their children's education. 

The implementing authority for the Maa-Badi scheme is the Department of Women and Child Development, Madhya Pradesh. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the establishment and functioning of the centres. 

Contact details for the department can be found on the official Madhya Pradesh government website. 

The Maa-Badi scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve child welfare in the state. 

It aligns with the National Policy for Children, 2013. 

The policy emphasizes the right to survival, development, protection, and participation for all children. 

The scheme also seeks to reduce the burden of childcare on working parents. 

By providing quality daycare services, it aims to empower women to join the workforce. 

The government expects that the Maa-Badi centres will promote gender equality. 

The scheme is also expected to contribute to the overall development of the state. 

By investing in early childhood education, the government aims to create a skilled future workforce. 

The success of the Maa-Badi scheme will be monitored through regular assessments. 

Feedback from parents and caregivers will be collected to improve services. 

The government plans to expand the scheme based on its success in the initial phase. 

The Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme represents a significant step towards improving child care in Madhya Pradesh. 

It reflects the government's commitment to enhancing the quality of life for children and families. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the educational landscape of the state. 

By focusing on early childhood development, the government aims to break the cycle of poverty. 

The Maa-Badi centres will serve as a model for similar initiatives in other states. 

The initiative is a testament to the importance of investing in the future of children. 

Overall, the Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme is a comprehensive approach to child welfare. 

It combines education, nutrition, and health services in a single framework. 

The scheme is poised to make a significant difference in the lives of many families in Madhya Pradesh. 

It is a proactive measure to ensure that every child has access to quality early childhood care. 

The government is optimistic about the positive outcomes of this initiative. 

The Maa-Badi scheme is a crucial element in the state's efforts to promote child rights. 

It aims to create a supportive environment for children to thrive and succeed.
